scope: Promote HVC serving views, outlet GA 5G/FWA variants, FTTH install orders and FB 5G kabkota market share after live profiling.

rham_hvc_highlevel_mth_serving.reason: Authoritative HVC total revenue and HVC subscriber source. Base highlevel HVC columns are frozen at the 2026-09-01 snapshot from 202609 onward.
rham_hvc_highlevel_mth_serving.evidence: Live 2026-10-04: mth 202608 serving hvc_rev_total 1,385.11B matches base. Mth 202609 serving 1,350.27B and subs_hvc 10,885,052 vs base 55.24B. Organic/trade/digital and stay/in/out remain wrong in serving from 202609, so they are reported as N/A. Scan about 4.6MB with an mth_dt literal.

rham_hvc_highlevel_mtd_serving.reason: MTD counterpart of the HVC serving view for current-month HVC revenue and subscribers.
rham_hvc_highlevel_mtd_serving.evidence: Live 2026-10-04: mtd 202610 hvc_rev_total 110.61B, subs_hvc 10,928,960. Organic/trade/digital/stay columns are NULL.

rham_outlet_ga_5g_mtd.reason: Outlet GA restricted to 5G-capable acquisitions (has_5g), MTD.
rham_outlet_ga_5g_mtd.evidence: Live profiling: GA equals has_5g rows of the outlet GA base. 38 of 256k rows have invalid coordinates, so coordinate validation is required for maps.

rham_outlet_ga_5g_mth.reason: Outlet GA restricted to 5G-capable acquisitions (has_5g), full month.
rham_outlet_ga_5g_mth.evidence: Live profiling: GA equals has_5g rows of the outlet GA base. Partition mth_dt, month_id STRING.

rham_outlet_ga_fwa_mtd.evidence: Live profiling: totals reconcile with rham_mkt_highlevel fwa_rgu_ga. outlet_mapping_status UNKNOWN rows exist.

rham_outlet_ga_fwa_mth.reason: Outlet-level FWA gross adds, full month.
rham_outlet_ga_fwa_mth.evidence: Live profiling: totals reconcile with rham_mkt_highlevel fwa_rgu_ga. outlet_mapping_status UNKNOWN rows exist.

rham_outlet_ga_fwa_5g_mtd.evidence: Live profiling 2026-10-04: same grain as outlet FWA GA, filtered to 5G FWA.

rham_outlet_ga_fwa_5g_mth.reason: Outlet-level FWA 5G gross adds, full month.
rham_outlet_ga_fwa_5g_mth.evidence: Live profiling 2026-10-04: same grain as outlet FWA GA, filtered to 5G FWA.

rham_outlet_ga_ex_dtu.reason: Outlet GA MTD excluding DTU-sourced acquisitions.
rham_outlet_ga_ex_dtu.evidence: Live profiling: equals outlet GA minus DTU source rows.

rham_outlet_ga_mth_ex_dtu.reason: Outlet GA full month excluding DTU-sourced acquisitions.
rham_outlet_ga_mth_ex_dtu.evidence: Live profiling: equals outlet GA full month minus DTU source rows.

rham_ftth_install_orders.reason: FTTH install order pipeline at order level. Customer and sales identity columns are blocked at runtime.
rham_ftth_install_orders.evidence: Live profiling: one row per bill_acc, snapshot load, no partition, about 8MB. PII columns customer_name, customer_id, bill_acc, sales_name, sales_code, manager, rm are listed as sensitive_dimensions and rejected by the SQL validator.

rham_fb_ms_5g_device.reason: Weekly FB 5G device market share by kabkota, absolute counts.
rham_fb_ms_5g_device.evidence: Live profiling: weekly dt_id, 30 snapshots, column kabkota, no partition. Different population from rham_report_fb_device_5g. Not summable across dt_id.

rham_fb_ms_5g_network.reason: Weekly FB 5G network market share by kabkota, absolute counts.
rham_fb_ms_5g_network.evidence: Live profiling: weekly dt_id, 30 snapshots, column kabkota, no partition. Different population from rham_report_fb_network_5g. Not summable across dt_id.

rham_hvc_snapshot_recovery.reason: Recovery staging behind the HVC serving views. Not a runtime source.
rham_hvc_snapshot_recovery.evidence: Serving views supersede it for runtime HVC totals.

rham_hvc_revenue_recovery.reason: Recovery staging behind the HVC serving views. Not a runtime source.
rham_hvc_revenue_recovery.evidence: Serving views supersede it for runtime HVC totals.

rham_kec_hvc_revenue.reason: Kecamatan HVC revenue detail pending reconciliation with serving totals.

rham_hvc_revenue_serving.reason: Intermediate serving table. The highlevel serving views are the approved interface.
rham_hvc_revenue_serving.evidence: Highlevel serving views cover the same totals with territory columns.
